dynamodb.create_table: twin-preferred: the twin reports TableId/TableClassSummary/TableSizeBytes (real AWS members) that moto omits from CreateTable
dynamodb.delete_table: twin-preferred: full DELETING description with the real-AWS members moto omits
dynamodb.describe_table: twin-preferred: same richer table description as create_table
dynamodb.get_item_duplicate_projection: twin-preferred: real AWS rejects overlapping projection paths; moto 5.2.5 silently dedupes them. The overlap text is moto's own template (exceptions.py:316)
dynamodb.list_tables_order: twin-preferred: real AWS returns table names in ascending order and the twin sorts; moto 5.2.5 walks table INSERTION order (models/__init__.py:139) — the twin's page contents (a stateful twin accumulates neighbor-corpus tables) also differ from a fresh moto during paged walks
dynamodb.query_wrong_types: twin-preferred: real AWS answers 400 ValidationException ('Condition parameter type does not match schema type'); moto crashes with a 500 on the same input
dynamodb.update_item: moto-only member: moto includes ConsumedCapacity without ReturnConsumedCapacity being requested; real AWS omits it and so does the twin
dynamodb.update_unresolved_name: twin-preferred: moto 500s (uncaught KeyError in the condition parser) where real AWS answers 400 ValidationException 'attribute name ... not defined'
iam_sts.list_access_keys: twin-preferred: real AWS always reports IsTruncated on ListAccessKeys; moto omits it
kms_secrets_ssm.encrypt: twin-preferred: the twin reports EncryptionAlgorithm SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT (a real-AWS response member) that moto omits
s3.complete_multipart: moto-only member: moto renders <VersionId>null</VersionId> for unversioned buckets; real AWS omits VersionId and the twin follows real AWS
s3.copy_archived_source: follow-up: same checksum slot gap — moto's CopyObjectResult carries ChecksumCRC32; the twin does not compute flex-checksums yet
s3.copy_in_place_replace: follow-up: same checksum slot gap — moto reports CopyObjectResult.ChecksumCRC32 (see s3.copy_object)
s3.copy_object: follow-up: same checksum slot gap — moto reports CopyObjectResult.ChecksumCRC32
s3.delete_objects_unknown_key: twin-preferred: real AWS creates a delete marker for a versioned delete of a never-written key; moto's _set_delete_marker raises on the missing key and books no marker
s3.delete_tagging_missing_version: twin-preferred: moto's delete_object_tagging dereferences a None key and 500s for a missing target; the twin answers the typed NoSuchVersion. twin-preferred: moto's delete_object_tagging dereferences a None key for every missing target (500); the twin answers typed 404/405 per the op
s3.get_archived_copy: twin-preferred destination-class gap: the twin keeps the GLACIER class on an archived copy per real-AWS inheritance (its dest GET answers 403 InvalidObjectState); moto drops the copy's class to STANDARD and the dest reads 200. twin-preferred: the twin preserves the GLACIER storage class on the copy per real AWS inheritance; moto drops the copy's class to STANDARD
s3.get_if_match_wrong: same code as moto (412 PreconditionFailed) but moto's error XML carries <Condition>If-Match</Condition> (moto s3/exceptions.py:360-367) which the twin omits — the extra element is the ledgered shape delta
s3.get_if_none_match_current: follow-up: same checksum slot gap — moto's stored checksum rides GET responses (x-amz-checksum-crc32); the twin does not yet compute flex-checksums on PUT or serve them on GET (own future tranche)
s3.head_glacier_unrestored: twin-preferred: real AWS gates HEAD on archive state (403 InvalidObjectState); moto's head_object has no storage-class check and answers 200 with the body length
s3.list_v1: twin-preferred: the twin echoes real AWS's Marker member on v1 listings; moto omits it
s3.list_v2_prefix: follow-up: real AWS (and moto) report ChecksumAlgorithm [CRC32] on objects stored without an explicit checksum — needs the ObjectVersion checksum slot recorded in crates/s3/src/aws_chunked.rs
s3.put_glacier_storage_class: follow-up: same checksum slot gap — moto's PUT response carries ChecksumCRC32; the twin does not compute flex-checksums yet
sqs.receive: twin-preferred: SenderId is the account id for account-style access keys (real AWS root-key behavior); moto reports a canned IAM user id for arbitrary keys
sqs_validation.create_fifo_bad: same-as-moto: both engines answer 400 InvalidParameterValue (Queue name must end in .fifo for FIFO queues) — pin
sqs_validation.create_mms_low: same-as-moto: 400 InvalidAttributeValue (Invalid value for the parameter MaximumMessageSize.)
sqs_validation.create_rp_badjson: same-as-moto: 400 InvalidParameterValue (Redrive policy is not a dict or valid json)
sqs_validation.create_rp_missing_arn: same-as-moto: 400 InvalidParameterValue (Redrive policy does not contain deadLetterTargetArn)
sqs_validation.create_rp_unknown_dlq: same-as-moto: 400 AWS.SimpleQueueService.NonExistentQueue (Could not find DLQ for arn)
